newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc more stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc more stable in late trade.

text.p: Zinc was more stable in London Metals Exchange late trading, after it set a bearish tone with a swift downturn earlier in the day.
But copper and aluminium both fell in late trade.
By 1800 GMT three months zinc was indicated at $1,460/$1,465, compared with last kerb business at $1,460.

Copper moved lower in late trade. By 1800 GMT it was indicated at $2,283/$2,288, compared with a kerb close of $2,305, and bringing it back near the day's low of $2,285, hit as it came down in sympathy with zinc's decline.
Aluminmum also came lower in late trade, indicated at $1,687/$1,690 compared with a kerb close of $1,697.
